message: 熱病の夜

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's enough... Any more than this...」

name: Azel
message: 「I have decided that I will nurse you...」

name: Azel
message: 「I will tend to you until you recover, Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But...」
Heat passes back and forth between our intertwined bodies.
If we stay like this any longer, I feel like I'm going to lose my mind.

name: Azel
message: 「I will not be satisfied if I stop here...」

name: Synn
message: 「That makes me... really happy, but...」

name: Azel
message: 「Then let me do as I wish...」
Azel's fingers trace over my body with gentle concern.

name: Synn
message: 「Ngh... Azel...」
Gazing into each other's eyes, we touch and grow feverish together.

name: Azel
message: 「I am worried about you, Synn...」

name: Azel
message: 「That is why I want you to get better soon...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」
Azel's single-minded kindness resonates in my heart through his palms.

name: Azel
message: 「How do you feel, Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like I'm starting to feel a bit better...」
Truth be told, my head feels like it's burning up, and I'm in no state to say I'm fine.
Yet, just having Azel lie beside me like this...
A sense of relief wells up alongside my racing heartbeat, feeling as though it's healing my body.

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe it's because you're staying by my side, Azel...」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so...」

name: Synn
message: 「Will you... stay like this with me...?」
I know full well that I probably shouldn't be asking for this.

name: Azel
message: 「If Synn wishes for it...」
Even though Azel must be suffering from the heat too...
Even so, I want you to stay right here beside me and watch over me.

name: Azel
message: 「Let's stay like this here forever......」
If we stay like this, a cold will clear right up...
Just being wrapped up in this warmth makes me feel that way...

name: Azel
message: 「I'll stay like this until you feel better, Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you, Azel...」
